title: Grant Producer — run output
description: The contract a producer run (Claude Code or Grok Build) emits. Matches Wire Room scan_entries shape (name, source_url, amount, deadline, wire, classification, quality_score) plus producer-attribution metadata so intake and the A/B split can attribute promotions per producer.

source_url.description: Canonical primary source (funder page, forum vote, or official post)

amount.description: Raw amount as written, e.g. '$45,000' / 'up to $250k' / 'not specified'. No derived totals.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences. The funder's own verb, facts only, amounts and dates as written. No derived counts, totals, averages, ratios, or percentages. Attributed commentary is quoted as the named person's view.

area.description: Wire area 1-6. 3 is an open funding opportunity. OUT items are rejected and are not emitted here.

classification.description: GRANT only when area is 3 (open program). grants.watch ingests GRANT. Areas 1, 2, 4, 5, and 6 are NEWS.

_verification_fields.description: Stamped by lib/verify.py after extraction (not emitted by the model): verified (bool), source_snippet (str|null), verification (object with status matched/missing/http_status/content_len). status ∈ verified|partial|unverified|fetch_failed.

rejected.description: Candidates considered but dropped, for the run report.
